title: wrap a time value into [min,max], or modular-wrap when the range's flag bit 0 is set
notes: range is float[4]: [0]=min, [1]=max/period, [3] low bits are the flag dword; bit 0 selects modular wrap.
Zero callees, no global reads: the first rung of the ladder.
argFactory=anim_time_wrap_fixture pins flag-bit sweep cases at the front of the corpus so a mask-widen mutant (bit0 test widened to bit1) is always discriminated.
The clamp is SSE minss/maxss (NaN -> second source), not IEEE-ordered ifs; the decompile's original sequential ifs were fixed after this harness caught the NaN divergence.
